notes: A field being present upstream does not make it detector-visible.
Ambiguous upstream fields must be quarantined until reviewed.
Conventional transliteration encodes deciphered phonetic readings and is permitted only for the explicitly named LB-PHONETIC condition. It is never substituted for graphical sign identity.

field_name_matching.rule: Allowed observation field names take precedence. Otherwise forbidden patterns match an exact field name or underscore/hyphen-delimited token; never arbitrary substrings.
